meta.audience: A youth player learning the fundamentals, or a volunteer or new coach learning to run a safe session, whose record is kept on an external platform.
meta.why: The ten-station programme runs here; a mastery gate over the three stations that carry the programme's biggest safety calls — the opening block, the first real contact and the scrimmage — decides whether the programme is handed on. The external node is the hand-off itself: the destination platform receives the node and the outcome and resumes the flow with its own verdict.
meta.hostNotes: The destination is the RBI platform (named by the user; not described in this repository). Nothing here assumes how it receives or stores anything. On reaching `ext-handoff` the app emits smartcitix:flow.external with the node and waits; whatever host speaks the existing flow contract resumes it with smartcitix:flow.resume and an outcome shaped like an attempt record (at minimum { passed }). The `ref` is an opaque string for the host to resolve.

nodes.title: Basketball Fundamentals
nodes.why: The programme itself: SmartCiti.X opens it at the first station the learner has not yet passed, exactly as its own Start button does.

nodes.title: Gate — run a safe youth session
nodes.why: Three stations carry the calls that matter most in a youth gym: the floor, water and emergency plan before practice, the first contact and a knock to the head, and a heated game closed with a check-in. Mastery on all three, read off the same attempt records the certificate rests on, or the learner goes back through the programme.

nodes.title: Hand-off to the external platform (host)
nodes.why: The programme's outcome is handed to the destination platform through the existing flow contract. This side parks on the node and waits; it asserts nothing about what the host does with it.

params.expects: smartcitix:flow.resume with { nodeId, outcome: { passed, stars?, seconds? } }
params.timeoutNote: There is no timeout: a flow parked on an external node stays parked until the host resumes it or an instructor restarts the flow.

nodes.title: Coach and player check-in
nodes.why: The programme closes on the guide's check-in rather than on a score: how the learner is after the heated game and the alarms, never graded and never leaving the learner's browser.
